title: Choose a Technic pin, keyed axle hole or bearing
applicability: Use when a beam joint must hold, slide or rotate. The shape of the hole, the fastener end and room to seat the fastener determine the applicable connection.
steps: Identify the exact hole profile before selecting a shaft. A round hole can serve as a bearing in a supported pairing. A cross hole holds the clocking of a matching axle.
On 7229, seat the 3705 axle in the central axle_hole at a keyed angle. Choose one end of the 2780 pin and a specific outer pin_hole for the secondary connection.
Check both holes, projection and collision at the seated poses. Use recorded joint kinds to choose degrees of freedom. Retention or friction under real load calls for a physical check.
expected: The beam, keyed axle and friction pin are connected and clear of mesh collisions in the seated configuration.
